commands: set -euo pipefail; test "$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {c++} END{print c+0}')" = '1'; PID=$(adb shell pidof io.blueeye | tr -d '\r'); test -n "$PID"; adb shell dumpsys activity services io.blueeye | grep -q 'ScannerService'; adb logcat -d -v brief --pid="$PID" | grep -E 'FATAL EXCEPTION|AndroidRuntime|OutOfMemoryError|SQLiteException|SecurityException|BLE scan failed' > /tmp/tracker-phase3-final-errors.txt || true; test ! -s /tmp/tracker-phase3-final-errors.txt || { cat /tmp/tracker-phase3-final-errors.txt; exit 41; }; echo PHASE3_FINAL_LOGCHECK_PASS
